name: Selma
seo_title: Selma Christmas Events for Kids 2026: 4 Events, 2 Free
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Selma, California for 2026: 4 family events, 2 free, with dates, times and addresses checked on each host's site.
lede: Selma kicks off Christmas with a downtown parade where Santa arrives, a new ice rink and a Nutcracker with a funny twist at its arts center.
celebrates: The Selma District Chamber of Commerce leads the season with its Christmas Parade, Santa's Arrival and Holiday Street Faire in downtown Selma. This year the City of Selma adds the Selma Holiday Magic Ice Rink, which opens the same afternoon with a ribbon cutting before the parade. A week later the Selma Arts Center stages A Nutty Nutcracker, presented by The Dancing School of Selma. Caruthers, a small town to the west, holds its own parade and WinterFest, and that listing sits here.
lastyear: The Selma chamber's events page lists the 2025 parade, which the chamber described with photos with Santa, crafts and food vendors in downtown Selma. The 2026 version keeps the parade and street faire and adds the first Selma Holiday Magic Ice Rink, a partnership announced by the City of Selma with the Selma Health Care District.
facts: The Selma Holiday Magic Ice Rink is a first for downtown, made possible by the Selma Health Care District and the Downtown Selma Business Improvement District, according to the City of Selma. The Selma Arts Center is the home of Full Scale Theater and lists dance and youth shows each season. Caruthers adds a Princess and Prince Pageant to its WinterFest.
trains: The closest real train ride for families is the Wahtoke Railroad steam train at Hillcrest Tree Farm, 6943 S Reed Ave in Reedley. The farm runs steam train rides and Santa photos on Saturdays and Sundays from November 28 to about December 20, 2026, with train tickets at $5 to $10 for ages 2 and up, plus moonlight Pajama Christmas train nights at $40 per person. We have not found a verified Christmas train event inside town limits.
traditions: The chamber's parade, with Santa arriving at 5:30 pm.
A downtown ice rink opening on parade day.
A comic Nutcracker at the Selma Arts Center.
A parade and pageant at the Caruthers Fair Grounds.
kidfact: Selma has a new ice rink downtown this year, and it opens the same day Santa arrives by parade.
faq: When is the Selma Christmas Parade in 2026?

The Selma District Chamber lists the parade and Santa's arrival for Saturday, December 5, 2026, at 5:30 pm in downtown Selma, with the street faire, vendors and skating until 9 pm. It is a public parade and free to watch. Call the chamber at 559-891-2235.
Is there an ice rink in Selma?

The City of Selma announced the Selma Holiday Magic Ice Rink, opening on Saturday, December 5, with a ribbon cutting at 3:45 pm and skating from 4 pm. Skating tickets are sold online through the city's ticket page, and the post gives no price.
It is a show presented by The Dancing School of Selma at the Selma Arts Center, 1935 High St, on December 12 at 4 pm and 7 pm and December 13 at 2 pm. Tickets are $17.
Why is a Caruthers event on the Selma page?
Caruthers has fewer than three verified events, so the Christmas Parade and WinterFest on December 4 is listed with Selma, the nearest larger town.

intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Selma for 2026, and here is what he found: 4 family events, 2 of them free. The magic runs from December 4 (Christmas Parade and WinterFest in Caruthers) through December 13 (A Nutty Nutcracker at the Selma Arts Center), with the Selma Christmas Parade and Santa's arrival and the Selma Holiday Magic Ice Rink (both December 5) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Selma

  • 4 Christmas events for kids in Selma, including one in Caruthers
  • 2 free events: the Selma Christmas Parade and the Caruthers Christmas Parade
  • Meet Santa: Santa's arrival at the Selma Christmas Parade (December 5)
  • Parades and tree lightings: Selma (December 5) and Caruthers (December 4)
  • Skating: the Selma Holiday Magic Ice Rink opens December 5
  • Season: December 4, 2026 to December 13, 2026
